summary: Li Auto Inc. filed a Form 6-K reporting the results of its annual general meeting (AGM) held on May 29, 2026, and the adoption of its seventh amended and restated memorandum and articles of association. The filing is a routine corporate governance update, not a special situation. There are no acquisition, divestiture, activist, tender offer, going-private, or restructuring events. The company simply announced shareholder approvals for charter amendments and director elections. No deal terms or strategic catalysts are present; thus, this is a standard foreign private issuer report.
